content.short: A permissionless lending protocol that allows users to create custom, non-custodial markets for any pair of tokens.
content.description:
Fraxlend is a permissionless lending platform within the Frax Finance ecosystem. It enables the creation of custom lending markets where users can deposit and borrow assets without centralized oversight. Each pair is isolated, ensuring risks are contained within individual markets and enhancing security. This design allows for a wide range of assets to be used as collateral, including unique DeFi derivatives.

The protocol leverages automated interest rate curves and oracle integration for efficient capital allocation. It empowers users to participate in decentralized credit markets as lenders or borrowers, building a robust financial infrastructure.
